_doc: Which canonical jobs (game/data/canonical/jobs.json) are playable in this build and what advancing grants (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 9). A job missing here is not playable with default_reason. Optional level overrides the canonical advancement level for survivor mode; an option above the player's level shows level_reason instead. grants.max_mp adds to computed base Max MP (Improved MaxMP Increase preserves the current MP ratio on growth). No job grants skills. Accepting a job opens an extra advancement skill draw before the level's normal draw; canonical skill prerequisites are ignored (tier C owner choice #31).
